severity_definition.P0: safety, secret disclosure, uncontrolled mutation, possible write or wrong target
severity_definition.P1: live blocker or false GO risk
severity_definition.P2: diagnostic weakness, bounded compatibility limit or artifact weakness

defects.failure_signature: unexpected process failure or timeout could leave no report artifact
defects.external_effect_before_failure: up to one connection and twenty-five SQL attempts were possible but previously unreported
defects.root_cause: upload lacked a guaranteed guarded fallback path and timeout termination was not bounded after TERM
defects.fix_required: always-run artifact guard, outcome binding, kill-after timeout and guarded exact-file upload
defects.test_added: workflow YAML symmetry, timeout, missing report, persistent write failure and outcome matrix

defects.failure_signature: configured NEON_PROJECT_ID made the controlled producer reject its own invocation
defects.root_cause: the sanitation-only project variable was injected into a producer that requires positive ownership discovery
defects.fix_required: remove project identity from the controlled live step while retaining it in the guard only
defects.test_added: exact workflow environment asymmetry assertion

defects.failure_signature: a truncated one-page inventory, malformed run objects or boolean run_attempt could prove false quiescence
defects.root_cause: the one-page envelope was not proven complete and Python equality coerced booleans to integers
defects.fix_required: require total_count equals the complete at-most-100 response, otherwise NO-GO; enforce exact integer types and fail-closed response validation
defects.test_added: zero/two dispatch, complete one-page and over-100 refusal, queued/in-progress, malformed payload, bool/float/string attempt and unavailable API cases

defects.failure_signature: PGHOSTADDR, PGPORT or PGCHANNELBINDING could redirect or downgrade a validated URI
defects.external_effect_before_failure: credential-bearing connection could target an unintended network address
defects.root_cause: the URI was passed to libpq without neutralizing ambient PG variables
defects.fix_required: reject every case-insensitive PG environment variable and pass canonical connection fields explicitly
defects.test_added: PGHOST, PGHOSTADDR, PGPORT, PGOPTIONS and PGSSLMODE pre-connect faults

defects.failure_signature: non-5432 URI ports and missing or downgraded channel binding were accepted
defects.root_cause: security fields were parsed independently from the direct-endpoint invariant
defects.fix_required: port 5432, direct hostname, secure sslmode and channel_binding=require as one canonical contract
defects.test_added: ordering, duplicates, overrides, encoded host, multi-host, pooler and TLS downgrade matrix

defects.failure_signature: benign legacy metadata caused false NO-GO while case-variant continuation keys caused false terminal inventory
defects.root_cause: brittle exact-shape allowlists combined with lowercase acceptance and lowercase-only reads
defects.fix_required: semantic continuation parsing, exact key casing, legacy previous compatibility, null terminal support and cycle fingerprints
defects.test_added: documented, legacy, additive, casing, null, empty, malformed, repeated and cyclic cursor fixtures

defects.failure_signature: string booleans, numeric strings, integer identifiers and transitioning states were coerced into valid observations
defects.root_cause: truthiness and permissive scalar conversion crossed trust boundaries
defects.fix_required: exact JSON scalar types, finite numbers and state-transition refusal
defects.test_added: coercion and missing-field fault matrix

defects.failure_signature: a first-page exact host could hide a later duplicate and duplicate endpoint IDs with different hosts were accepted
defects.root_cause: candidate-first discovery returned before proving inventory uniqueness
defects.fix_required: continue bounded project inventory and require one exact host across the exhaustive owner scope
defects.test_added: later-page duplicate host and duplicate endpoint identifier replays

defects.failure_signature: personal API keys compared a user ID with organization-owned Project.owner_id or treated accessible projects as owner-wide inventory
defects.root_cause: the preflight modeled the retired user-owned project topology
defects.fix_required: auth scope proof, explicit or unique organization selection, exact admin membership witness and org_id-bound project listing
defects.test_added: org key, project-scoped key, mono/multi-org personal key, admin/non-admin and opaque owner identities

defects.failure_signature: foreign shared projects consumed the target discovery budget or a partial personal inventory proved owner-wide capacity
defects.root_cause: accessible and owned project sets were not separated and owner authority was not proved
defects.fix_required: count only selected-owner projects and require organization-wide or personal-admin authority
defects.test_added: mixed owned/shared inventory and bounded six/seven project limits

defects.failure_signature: target list count and authoritative /branches/count could disagree while capacity remained true
defects.root_cause: owner totals discarded their per-project provenance
defects.fix_required: retain counts by project and require target count equals exhaustive target branch inventory
defects.test_added: nine-listed versus ten-counted contradiction

defects.failure_signature: owner hard branch limit was conflated with the per-project bill-free allowance
defects.root_cause: one capacity boolean represented two independent contracts
defects.fix_required: separate hard capacity from billing allowance and derive free/launch/scale boundaries from authoritative plan evidence
defects.test_added: free/launch 9-to-10, scale 24-to-25, unknown/custom and plan/subscription contradiction cases

defects.failure_signature: a hard-coded PostgreSQL 16 expectation blocked valid Neon versions while uncertified 17/18 support risked false GO
defects.root_cause: provider support and repository certification were not separate contracts
defects.fix_required: bind server major to project.pg_version and authorize only repository-certified PostgreSQL 16
defects.test_added: PG16 pass, PG17/18 certification NO-GO and Neon/server mismatch

defects.failure_signature: valid 60-second suspension and direct host with deprecated pooler flag could be rejected; valid high maximum CU could be mistaken for inability to suspend
defects.root_cause: arbitrary thresholds and deprecated fields overrode current hostname and compute contracts
defects.fix_required: documented timeout range, hostname-authoritative pooling and finite minimum-CU validation independent of the maximum CU setting
defects.test_added: 0, 60, 604800, -1, missing, type and maximum-CU values through 1000001

defects.failure_signature: multiple defaults or a production branch with an unexpected parent could reach GO
defects.root_cause: default uniqueness and root-parent semantics were reported but not gated
defects.fix_required: exactly one boolean default and null production parent before connection
defects.test_added: multiple default, string default, project mismatch and non-null parent replays

defects.failure_signature: an exact admin membership after the first 500 rows caused a false owner-capacity NO-GO
defects.root_cause: the membership witness inspected only one cursor page
defects.fix_required: follow up to three pages with cycle detection and dynamically recompute the project GET budget
defects.test_added: admin on second page, missing admin, non-admin and continuation-with-first-page-witness cases

defects.failure_signature: wrong database, wrong session principal or unsupported server could produce GO
defects.external_effect_before_failure: one read-only connection to the wrong target
defects.root_cause: parsed DSN identity was hashed but never compared with server observations
defects.fix_required: exact database, session user, current user and project/server major gates
defects.test_added: wrong database, principal and PG major short-circuit cases

defects.failure_signature: driver implicit BEGIN preceded the claimed BEGIN READ ONLY
defects.root_cause: psycopg autocommit default was false
defects.fix_required: connect with autocommit true and retain explicit BEGIN READ ONLY plus ROLLBACK
defects.test_added: exact connect kwargs and eighteen-statement ledger replay

defects.failure_signature: SSL/read-only/timeout failures and a malicious alembic view were discovered only after later SQL or user-object access
defects.external_effect_before_failure: a user-defined view, FDW, rule or function could execute inside a read-only transaction
defects.root_cause: classification and immediate fail gates followed the revision SELECT
defects.fix_required: short-circuit each session gate, classify from catalogs before any user read, then lock and reclassify
defects.test_added: ordinal fault matrix and no-later-SQL assertions for every early gate

defects.failure_signature: role/database search_path could shadow catalog functions or operators
defects.root_cause: startup options did not pin pg_catalog
defects.fix_required: search_path=pg_catalog before the first SQL and qualified catalog calls
defects.test_added: startup option and SHOW search_path contract

defects.failure_signature: the classified table could be replaced before revision read
defects.external_effect_before_failure: possible execution of an unclassified replacement object
defects.root_cause: READ COMMITTED catalog proof held no relation lock
defects.fix_required: SHARE lock, second catalog proof and stable schema/table OID equality before ONLY read
defects.test_added: ordered classification-lock-reclassification contract and OID mismatch fault

defects.failure_signature: stale roles, memberships, relations, functions, standalone types or index-name collisions could still produce GO
defects.root_cause: inventories were evidence-only and incomplete
defects.fix_required: gate empty role/membership/object inventories and include every 0014 relation, function, type and named index collision
defects.test_added: partial role, unexpected membership, object, standalone type and uq_chronos index cases

defects.failure_signature: inherited WITH GRANT OPTION or superuser non-owner could pass preflight but fail the mutation postcondition grantor topology
defects.root_cause: effective privilege functions did not prove the grantor recorded by PostgreSQL 16
defects.fix_required: direct/current ownership or grantable ACL proof plus SET LOCAL ROLE schema owner and PostgreSQL-16-valid plain GRANT
defects.test_added: superuser, CREATEROLE non-superuser, inherited edge and schema-owner lifecycle contracts

defects.failure_signature: trigger, rule, inheritance, RLS, extra constraint, hostile ACL or noncanonical index could pass a shallow relkind check
defects.external_effect_before_failure: read-only inspection or future 0014 could invoke hostile behavior
defects.root_cause: the catalog classifier was not an exact canonical-table proof
defects.fix_required: exact column, constraint, index, trigger/rule/policy, inheritance and ACL topology before and after lock
defects.test_added: static SQL semantics and adversarial capability faults

defects.failure_signature: custom table/index access methods, opclasses, publication, subscription or active event triggers could remain hidden
defects.external_effect_before_failure: custom callbacks or replication/DDL hooks on future 0014
defects.root_cause: logical shape checks omitted physical access and external hook catalogs
defects.fix_required: heap, btree pg_catalog.text_ops, exact default type collation, tablespace/options/replica identity and zero active publication/subscription/event hooks
defects.test_added: both catalog probes assert every storage, opclass, replication and DDL-hook predicate

defects.failure_signature: the first exact-shape patch required NOT connoinherit and rejected every canonical PostgreSQL 16 primary key
defects.root_cause: the meaning of pg_constraint.connoinherit was inverted
defects.fix_required: require connoinherit=true for the canonical local primary key
defects.test_added: explicit coninhcount, conislocal and connoinherit SQL contract assertion

defects.failure_signature: a role-named schema before public could redirect unqualified version-table resolution
defects.external_effect_before_failure: only a future separately authorized 0014 migration
defects.root_cause: the migration connection inherited the role/database search_path
defects.fix_required: pg_catalog-only session path and explicit public version_table_schema; 0014 objects remain public-qualified
defects.test_added: fenced runner and migration environment source contract

defects.failure_signature: decision NO-GO lacked failed_gate and owner_role could be emitted raw
defects.root_cause: decision and exception report paths had divergent schemas and new identity fields were not fingerprinted
defects.fix_required: shared deterministic gate mapping and recursive identity hashing
defects.test_added: NO-GO family schemas and owner-role non-disclosure

defects.failure_signature: late exception or first serialization failure replaced observed one-connection effects with false zeros
defects.external_effect_before_failure: up to one possible wake, one connection and twenty-five SQL attempts
defects.root_cause: fallback constructed a fresh empty audit object
defects.fix_required: observed attempted/completed ledgers or explicit conservative upper-bound certainty
defects.test_added: fault after connect, every SQL ordinal and serialization-after-GO

defects.failure_signature: minimal or contradictory GO and arbitrary nested NO-GO maps were accepted
defects.root_cause: top-level key presence checks replaced recursive exact variants and cross-document invariants
defects.fix_required: closed GO/NO-GO schemas, source/outcome binding and exact lifecycle/effect/counter relationships
defects.test_added: mutation matrix for every source, verdict, counter, nested key and lifecycle relation

defects.failure_signature: a duplicate JSON key could hide a secret in raw bytes while json.loads retained a safe later value
defects.root_cause: validation inspected only the last duplicate key value
defects.fix_required: reject duplicate keys recursively before validation and atomically replace the artifact
defects.test_added: top-level and nested duplicate keys containing API key, DSN and password

defects.failure_signature: raw identifiers, cursors or credentials could hide in free strings, fingerprints or dynamic timestamp/version fields
defects.external_effect_before_failure: secret or raw identity artifact upload
defects.root_cause: key-name scanning and known-value exact matches were neither recursively closed nor field-aware
defects.fix_required: closed value vocabularies, normalized secret inputs, entropy floor and substring scanning only in opaque/dynamic fields
defects.test_added: short, padded, encoded, timestamp, fingerprint and fixed-vocabulary collision cases

defects.failure_signature: GO fingerprints for project, owner, endpoint host, database or principal were format-valid but unrelated to current environment
defects.external_effect_before_failure: false GO artifact for a wrong target
defects.root_cause: hash shape was checked without recomputing authoritative inputs
defects.fix_required: canonical DSN and pure project/org hash bindings plus zero ambient libpq environment
defects.test_added: absent, malformed, wrong and empty API/DSN/project/org plus fingerprint mutation cases

defects.failure_signature: malformed IPv6 DSN or benign DSN component collision crashed fallback generation and produced no artifact
defects.root_cause: urlparse component access was not guarded and fallback was scanned like an untrusted producer report
defects.fix_required: exception-safe sensitive extraction and separately validated internally generated conservative fallback
defects.test_added: invalid IPv6, encoded credential, /readonly and short password subprocess cases

defects.failure_signature: upload could run after guard failure or publish an unintended directory/path
defects.external_effect_before_failure: publication of invalid or sensitive bytes
defects.root_cause: upload was unconditional with path semantics broader than one verified file
defects.fix_required: guard step id, upload only on guard success, exact hidden file and if-no-files-found error
defects.test_added: live/guard/upload path identity, directory path, nonzero producer and guard failure cases

defects.failure_signature: a skipped dependency install made the guard import psycopg transitively and prevented fallback creation
defects.root_cause: the recovery boundary depended on the runtime whose absence it had to recover
defects.fix_required: stdlib-only guard and exact python -S subprocess recovery
defects.test_added: missing-runtime python -S guard fallback and workflow skipped-outcome path

defects.failure_signature: a secret or variable containing CR or LF could inject a second workflow-command line
defects.external_effect_before_failure: possible partial secret logging or workflow command injection
defects.root_cause: raw values were interpolated into ::add-mask::
defects.fix_required: escape percent, carriage return and line feed before every masking command
defects.test_added: symmetric YAML assertion and shell replay with percent/CR/LF

defects.failure_signature: the synthetic Neon DSN fixture matched the production-DSN heuristic and made the main tests job fail
defects.root_cause: a documentation-safe fixture still used the provider hostname signature
defects.fix_required: mark exact deliberate synthetic DSN literals with the scanner's auditable SECRET_SCANNER_TEST_FIXTURE marker
defects.test_added: scripts/check_no_secrets.py in the stable validation pack

defects.failure_signature: the newly included end-to-end test imported Alembic and SQLAlchemy absent from the readonly lock
defects.external_effect_before_failure: live step never started; guarded fallback only
defects.root_cause: a test-only transitive import exceeded the deliberately minimal live dependency set
defects.fix_required: decouple the test module from bootstrap imports and preserve the hashed minimal lock
defects.test_added: fresh specialized-lock collection contract and exact workflow pytest command

defects.failure_signature: unauthenticated shared-runner requests could exhaust the low IP rate limit before Neon inspection
defects.root_cause: the workflow omitted actions:read and the current-run token
defects.fix_required: step-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN, actions:read and a strict bearer header
defects.test_added: authenticated header, missing token and malformed token cases

defects.failure_signature: duplicate current-run IDs were excluded twice and could falsely prove queued or in-progress quiescence
defects.root_cause: row shape was validated without response-local identity uniqueness
defects.fix_required: reject duplicate run IDs in every queued, in-progress and dispatch response
defects.test_added: duplicate identity faults in all three GitHub inventories

defects.failure_signature: ambient proxy, CA bundle or netrc state could reroute or re-authorize credential-bearing requests
defects.external_effect_before_failure: possible API credential disclosure to an unintended transport
defects.root_cause: requests trusted process environment defaults
defects.fix_required: dedicated trust_env=false sessions, redirects disabled and explicit headers
defects.test_added: proxy, CA, netrc and redirect boundary faults

defects.failure_signature: duplicate identity, pagination or run keys were silently resolved last-wins
defects.root_cause: requests response.json used the default duplicate-key semantics
defects.fix_required: unique-object parsing at both external boundaries
defects.test_added: duplicate project, endpoint, pagination, head_sha and run identity payloads

defects.failure_signature: summary/detail owner_id or present org_id contradictions could be ignored or incorrectly equated
defects.root_cause: legacy opaque owner identity and current organization scope were modeled as one identifier
defects.fix_required: bind org_id when present to selected scope and require opaque owner_id summary/detail consistency
defects.test_added: absent, concordant and contradictory owner/org fixtures

defects.failure_signature: unknown links.next or metadata.has_more descendants could hide an incomplete inventory
defects.root_cause: continuation detection inspected only keys at the current level
defects.fix_required: bounded recursive semantic-token rejection outside documented opaque maps
defects.test_added: nested links, has_more and harmless metadata cases

defects.failure_signature: a non-null previous value on the first request could certify a page starting mid-inventory
defects.root_cause: legacy metadata was accepted without request-cursor binding
defects.fix_required: reject every non-null previous cursor in the bounded forward-only proof
defects.test_added: first-page and continuation non-null previous faults

defects.failure_signature: the target row could agree while another returned endpoint belonged to a foreign branch
defects.root_cause: expected branch ownership was checked only on the candidate endpoint
defects.fix_required: bind every row in a branch-scoped response to the requested branch
defects.test_added: valid target plus foreign branch endpoint replay

defects.failure_signature: configured identity skipped endpoint detail and branch-endpoint ownership confirmation
defects.root_cause: configuration was treated as a substitute for the full positive endpoint witness
defects.fix_required: execute the same endpoint detail and branch-scoped confirmation on configured identity
defects.test_added: disabled detail and foreign branch endpoint faults on the configured path

defects.failure_signature: an unrelated endpoint could reference a branch absent from the exhaustive target branch inventory
defects.root_cause: only the DSN candidate endpoint was cross-checked with branch identity
defects.fix_required: require every target-project endpoint branch_id to exist in the exhaustive branch set
defects.test_added: valid candidate plus dangling endpoint branch replay

defects.failure_signature: project or branch IDs containing next/link inside applications, integrations or annotations maps looked like pagination
defects.root_cause: documented identity-indexed maps were recursively interpreted as unknown continuation metadata
defects.fix_required: recognize the documented opaque maps while keeping real pagination fields strict
defects.test_added: OpenAPI-shaped maps with continuation-token substrings in valid IDs

defects.failure_signature: uppercase ACTIVE or READY was normalized into an in-contract state
defects.root_cause: external enum strings were lowercased before validation
defects.fix_required: exact case-sensitive documented endpoint and branch states
defects.test_added: uppercase endpoint and branch state faults

defects.failure_signature: an unrelated login could inherit or SET the lifecycle, schema-owner or table-owner role while classification stayed safe
defects.root_cause: ACL grantees were checked without recursively inventorying effective membership paths into protected authority roots
defects.fix_required: reject every direct or transitive descendant of actor, effective schema owner and effective table owner other than the inspected actor
defects.test_added: real PostgreSQL direct and transitive hostile membership fixtures across protected roots

defects.failure_signature: rejecting neon_superuser caused canonical Neon false NO-GO, while accepting it without exclusive membership allowed a hostile peer
defects.root_cause: provider-managed grantable ACL topology and implicit global-writer membership were neither modeled nor recursively constrained
defects.fix_required: allow the documented NOLOGIN neon_superuser ACL only when its effective descendant set is the actor, and reject unrelated explicit descendants of pg_write_all_data without treating every superuser as a member
defects.test_added: real PG16 platform ACL for both profiles, direct/transitive hostile descendants, global-writer sibling and superuser false-positive fixtures

defects.failure_signature: SSL, read-only, revision and authority observations acquired before a PG gate were dropped
defects.external_effect_before_failure: up to one connection and bounded read-only SQL
defects.root_cause: the exception path retained Neon evidence only
defects.fix_required: strict sanitized partial PostgreSQL evidence in PreflightNoGo and guard variants
defects.test_added: revision, SSL, authority and close-failure partial-evidence reports

defects.failure_signature: reason, gate, inspection phase, SQL prefix and populated observations could describe mutually impossible executions
defects.root_cause: the closed partial schema lacked cross-document progress invariants
defects.fix_required: bind reason to gate, phase to exact effect bounds, the fixed SQL-read ordinal prefix to evidence, and terminal failure class to the first failed operation
defects.test_added: forged pre-connection effects, every SQL ordinal, row/timeout/revision/close disguises and execute/result/control/rollback/close failure classes

defects.failure_signature: technical fallback omitted the possible twenty-five Neon reads or ordinary reports exposed no mirrored GET effect
defects.root_cause: the effect ledger did not carry the live client's count through every early and late exception path
defects.fix_required: require neon_get_count with exact observed or conservative maximum certainty and bind it to the sanitized Neon observation when present
defects.test_added: GO, pre-GET, mid-GET, post-resolution, controlled/pure late failure and guard fallback counter contracts

defects.failure_signature: deep, oversized or type-hostile valid JSON could raise RecursionError, OverflowError or TypeError and bypass fallback generation
defects.root_cause: untrusted parse and validation recovery did not impose a byte ceiling or total no-throw exception boundary
defects.fix_required: read at most one MiB plus one byte, reject excess, and catch every ordinary parse or validation exception before writing a conservative fallback
defects.test_added: ten-thousand-level nesting, over-one-MiB payload, five-thousand-digit integer, unhashable enum and overflowing numeric artifact inputs

defects.failure_signature: the mission manifest authorized a controlled dispatch that the global activation matrix still denied
defects.root_cause: mission-specific external effects cannot override the unchanged global deny rule
defects.fix_required: exact bounded matrix exception for one new controlled attempt-one dispatch after green merged main, Pages and quiescence
defects.test_added: exact workflow, prior run, prior SHA and sequencing authority assertions

defects.failure_signature: the real canonical catalog proof ran against the pull-request merge ref rather than the immutable PR head
defects.root_cause: the reusable workflow inherited checkout defaults and received no exact commit input
defects.fix_required: caller passes the exact PR head and every reusable-workflow checkout pins it
defects.test_added: caller input plus all four checkout ref assertions

defects.failure_signature: the non-superuser profile retained the prior superuser membership and rejected its own exclusive-platform-ACL proof
defects.root_cause: both lifecycle profiles shared one provider-role fixture without resetting its member set
defects.fix_required: revoke every prior platform member before installing the profile actor, then independently inject and remove a hostile peer
defects.test_added: real PG16 superuser and CREATEROLE classifier runs with isolated sole-member plus hostile-peer states

defects.failure_signature: when org_id was absent, a foreign owner_id could pass selected-organization proof
defects.root_cause: owner_id was treated as opaque even when it was the only available ownership field
defects.fix_required: bind owner_id to selected organization only when org_id is absent; otherwise bind org_id and preserve owner summary/detail consistency
defects.test_added: foreign summary and detail owner without org_id plus current dual-field example

defects.failure_signature: a secondary close failure during an already classified primary failure is not separately visible
defects.external_effect_before_failure: none beyond the already bounded connection
defects.root_cause: connection close completion was absent from the attempted/completed audit ledger
defects.fix_required: retain the primary gate while emitting connection_close_completed=false in partial evidence
defects.test_added: close failure and rollback/close double-fault coverage

defects.failure_signature: an attempt-one dispatch on an obsolete main SHA could satisfy dispatch uniqueness and inspect the wrong target after main advanced
defects.external_effect_before_failure: bounded authenticated GitHub GET only; Neon and PostgreSQL remain unreachable
defects.root_cause: GITHUB_SHA was syntax-checked and matched to the run but never compared with refs/heads/main at the authorization point
defects.fix_required: read and strictly parse refs/heads/main after the Actions inventories, require its commit SHA equals GITHUB_SHA, and map mismatch or malformed state to an all-zero NO-GO
defects.test_added: stale main, malformed ref, exact-ref order, no-Neon-after-mismatch and guard reason/gate/effect binding

defects.failure_signature: attempt two could execute checkout/setup, write a pip cache and publish a fallback artifact before or after the step-level rerun refusal
defects.external_effect_before_failure: GitHub cache and artifact mutations were possible on an unauthorized rerun
defects.root_cause: the rerun check was a late step while the job and always-run artifact path remained eligible
defects.fix_required: job-level run_attempt==1 gate, first-step duplicate refusal, no setup-python cache, and exact attempt-one guard/upload assertions
defects.test_added: job condition, first-step order, absent cache, exact guard/upload path and attempt-two exclusion

defects.failure_signature: six pg_catalog.coalesce calls parsed as nonexistent qualified functions and made the canonical classifier fail universally on PostgreSQL 16
defects.external_effect_before_failure: one read-only connection and the prefix before classifier ordinal eight
defects.root_cause: COALESCE is special SQL grammar and cannot be schema-qualified like a pg_proc function
defects.fix_required: use unqualified COALESCE in both byte-symmetric classifiers and inspect every remaining qualified call against PostgreSQL 16
defects.test_added: exact before/after classifier symmetry, qualified-call audit and real PG16 runner contract

defects.failure_signature: a sibling login explicitly inheriting pg_write_all_data could update alembic_version without appearing in its ACL, while pg_has_role also mislabeled every superuser as such a member
defects.root_cause: effective global privileges are absent from relacl and pg_has_role MEMBER includes superuser bypass rather than only grant topology
defects.fix_required: walk explicit pg_auth_members descendants from pg_write_all_data, reject unrelated effective logins, and never use pg_has_role for this topology proof
defects.test_added: hostile global-writer login plus existing infrastructure superusers under both runner profiles

defects.failure_signature: a descendant of the database owner could inherit ownership of public or alembic_version through pg_database_owner without any pg_auth_members edge to that predefined role
defects.root_cause: the classifier seeded raw namespace and relation owners but did not resolve pg_database_owner to current_database.datdba
defects.fix_required: derive effective schema and table owner OIDs from datdba when the raw owner is pg_database_owner, then include both effective roots in recursive membership and capability proofs
defects.test_added: hostile descendant fixtures for implicit schema ownership and implicit table ownership with deterministic restoration

defects.failure_signature: column-only SELECT on pg_authid.rolname made preflight GO although bootstrap immediately requires rolpassword visibility
defects.root_cause: the preflight probe referenced fewer protected columns than the bootstrap authority assertion
defects.fix_required: reference rolname and rolpassword in an aggregate boolean that reveals no password and classify permission denial as privileged_catalog_not_visible
defects.test_added: real PG16 revoke-table/grant-rolname-only fault, integrated NO-GO evidence and restoration

defects.failure_signature: noncanonical storage, compression, statistics, options, fast-default residue, a dropped ghost column, extended statistics or stale rule/trigger/subclass flags could pass exact-shape proof
defects.root_cause: the classifier proved active objects but omitted mutable pg_attribute fields and pg_class fields that record historical topology
defects.fix_required: pin canonical varchar storage/compression/statistics/options/default/missing/local dimensions, relnatts=1, zero statistic_ext, and false stale relation flags in both classifiers
defects.test_added: independent transactional PG16 mutations for every storage/statistics/missing/dropped/statistic/rule/trigger/inheritance shape

defects.failure_signature: alembic_version, public, its row or array type could become extension members, or its primary index could depend automatically on an extension, while direct table shape remained canonical
